subject: Offer components: L3 SDE proposed mix & accelerated vesting question
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft offer for Ethan — quick review requested

Hi team,

Attached is the draft offer for Ethan (L3 SDE). Loretta from TalentPartners flagged a potential ask from the candidate for an accelerated early-vesting on 25% of the RSU grant at the 12-month mark (instead of standard 1-year cliff + 3-year linear thereafter). He is also asking for a 10% signing bonus to help with relocation timing.

High-level proposed mix in the attached v1:
- Base: $168,000 (mid of L3 band)
- Annual target bonus: 10%
- Equity: 12,000 RSUs, 4-year schedule with 1-year cliff (standard)
- Signing bonus: $0 in v1

Questions for approval:
1) Are we comfortable making an exception for accelerated vesting (25% at 12 months) for this candidate?
2) If not, any flexibility on signing bonus (up to $15k) as tradeoff?
3) Confirm base and equity counts vs band reference.

Please reply with thumbs-up / edit suggestions. If helpful, I can push a revised PDF for signature after we align.

Thanks,
--
Karthik Iyer
Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Offer_L3_SDE_v1.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
Attachment: comp-band-L3-reference.xlsx (xlsx, 12KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Ethan — quick review requested

Thanks Karthik — quick thoughts below.

- Base looks fine (within band). If we push base higher we should align total comp expectation with TS/infra norms.
- Signing bonus: I am okay up to $10k as one-time (relocation bridge), but prefer not to go above unless the candidate has competing offers we can't match.
- Accelerated vesting: this is the tricky one. We generally don’t do partial accelerated vesting at 12 months outside of senior roles. It sets a precedent. Two alternatives that preserve hiring momentum:
  * Option A (preferred): Keep standard 1-year cliff, offer a $7.5k signing bonus, and guarantee a performance review + promotion conversation at 12 months tied to accelerated refresh grants.
  * Option B: Approve 25% accelerated vesting at 12 months for this hire only with sign-off from me + People Ops (we'll need a memo).

If you think Ethan needs a stronger signal to accept, Option A is lower risk and quicker. If this is a hot candidate with competing offers, propose Option B but loop in People Ops.

I’ll draft suggested wording for the offer doc depending on which path we take.

Sooj
--
Soojin Lee
Director, Talent & People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T15:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft offer for Ethan — quick review requested

Following Soojin — adding People Ops perspective.

- We need to avoid policy drift on accelerated vesting; approving an exception requires a one-paragraph justification (business need + candidate scarcity) and sign-off from myself and Soojin.
- If the team prefers Option A, PM/manager should commit to a 12-month formal calibration (metrics for accelerated refresh). We'll add a clause: "Eligibility for additional equity grant following first-year performance review; not guaranteed."
- Signing bonus up to $12,000 is acceptable if hiring is at risk. Please provide evidence of competing offers or a TA note from Loretta if you want the higher amount.

If Karthik confirms candidate pressure (timeline + competing offer), I can approve Option B with a one-time memo; otherwise we default to Option A.

Kimberly
--
Kimberly Park
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-03T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Offer v2 (Ethan) — approving Option B with memo

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Candidate context: Loretta confirms Ethan has two competing offers, one at a higher base but lower equity. He is deciding this week and requested an explicit 12-month partial vest ask. Given risk of losing him, I recommend we approve Option B as a one-time exception.

Per process, attached is Offer_L3_SDE_v2.pdf which includes: 
- Base: $170,000
- Annual target bonus: 10%
- Equity: 12,000 RSUs, 4-year schedule with 25% vest at 12 months, remaining vesting monthly thereafter
- Signing bonus: $10,000 (one-time)
- Clause: Exception memo (approved by Soojin & Kimberly) attached as a comment in the offer doc.

Marissa: can you please prepare the formal exception memo (2–3 sentences) and post to the candidate file? Soojin/Kimberly: if you reply-all with final sign-off I will route to Loretta to present to Ethan and then DocuSign.

Thanks —
Karthik
--

Hiring Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference
